title: Courgette And Mince Bake
preamble:
Ingredients:-
Courgette Base
1
large courgette
1
teaspoon salt
2
large eggs
⅔
cup parmesan cheese, grated
1
½ cups cheese, shredded
Meaty Middle Layer
1
½ pounds ground beef, pork, sausage meat
1
large onion, chopped
2
cups mushrooms, fresh, sliced
½
cup peppers, green, orange, yellow or red, chopped
1
tin tomatoes,
1-2
tablespoons Italian Seasoning, if desired
Topping
1
½ cups cheese, shredded, more or less to taste

1
½ cups cheese, shredded, more or less to taste

Method:-
Preheat your oven to Gas Mark 6
Grease a large and deep Pyrex dish (9 to 10 inch diameter)
Courgette Base
Place grated courgette in a strainer, sprinkle with salt and toss. Let stand for 15 minutes.
Add beaten eggs, parmesan cheese and half of the shredded cheeses to the courgette.
Stir until combined.
Press, as evenly as possible, into your prepared Pyrex dish
Bake, uncovered, for 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and set aside until needed.
Meaty Middle Layer
In a large skillet or saucepan, sauté mushrooms and onion over medium heat until start to soften.
Add ground meat of choice, break up and cook until no longer pink.
Add peppers.
Stir until blended. Drain if necessary.
Add tomatoes
Cook until it is a good ragout
Topping
Put meat ragout onto the courgette mixture
Sprinkle with cheese and add more or less to taste.
Bake for another 20 minutes
Allow to rest for 10 minutes before serving
